name: Jøtul F 305
description: The Jøtul F 305 is a classic cast iron stove with clean Scandinavian lines and exceptional heat retention. Once fired up, the dense cast iron absorbs heat and radiates it steadily for hours — even after the fire dies down. Perfect for Nairobi highland evenings and cold seasons upcountry.
features: Large glass door for flame viewing
Cast iron construction for long heat retention
